parameters.query:
select
  count(*)::int as total,
  coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object(
    'id', id, 'session_id', session_id, 'channel', channel, 'route', route, 'category', category, 'urgency', urgency,
    'complaint_topic', complaint_topic, 'escalation_reason', escalation_reason,
    'message', left(message, 600)
  ) order by received_at), '[]'::json) as messages
from support_messages
where received_at > now() - interval '24 hours';

parameters.text:
=You help the owner of Saltgrove Skin, an online skincare store, see what customers ask about that the help documents do not cover.

Give each customer message below a short topic label: 2 to 5 words in English that name what the customer wants (for example "Rewards or points program", "Wholesale pricing").
- Messages that ask for the same thing must get exactly the same label, even when they are worded differently or only hint at it.
- Use plain words a shop owner understands. No customer names, emails or order numbers.
- Do not answer the questions.
- Return one label for every message id.

Messages (JSON):
{{ $json.questions_json }}

parameters.content:
## Saltgrove – Daily Report
Every day at 5 pm Pacific, one Slack message to #daily-report for the owner. First line: tickets still waiting for a person. Then the last 24 hours: messages and what happened to them, the top complaints, and questions the help docs could not answer.

Code does all the counting. AI only names the topics of the unanswered questions, so questions that mean the same thing are grouped. The report is sent even on a quiet day, so a missing report means something broke.

### 1. Gather (code)
Messages from the last 24 hours (Supabase) and tickets that are not resolved yet (Airtable).

### 2. Name the topics (AI)
Only for questions the help docs could not answer. AI gives each one a short topic label, so the same question asked in different words lands in one group. Skipped when there are none.

### 3. Count and send (code)
Code counts everything and writes one Slack message for the owner. Sent even on a quiet day.
